healthy.description: groups healthy fixture failures by program
healthy.sql: SELECT program AS key, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, count(*) AS events, min(ts_utc) AS first_seen, max(ts_utc) AS last_seen FROM observation WHERE program = 'healthy-tool' AND ts_utc >= :window_start_utc GROUP BY program

sql_error.sql: SELECT no_such_column AS key, count(*) AS sessions, count(*) AS events, min(ts_utc) AS first_seen, max(ts_utc) AS last_seen FROM observation WHERE ts_utc >= :window_start_utc GROUP BY no_such_column
